baseline_models.focus_anchor: جاءت رسلنا لوطا سيء بهم وضاق بهم ذرعا
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated بهم first makes the arrivals the object of distress and constriction: their coming is registered as an incoming protective burden before they disclose what they can do.

activation_trace.role: Arrival and occurrence supply the entry event that begins the pressure sequence.
Message-bearers supply agents whose role is not yet legible to Lot at arrival.
What causes gloom or distress marks the arrivals as an apparent liability.
Constriction of the breast supplies the felt overload produced by that apparent liability.

changed_reading.before: The messengers arrive and Lot simply feels bad about the situation.
changed_reading.after: Their arrival is first experienced as a new burden that Lot believes his protective capacity cannot absorb.

baseline_models.mechanism: Narrowness, arm, measurement, and capacity converge: distress is spatialized as a protective radius whose measure is too short for the demand placed upon it.

activation_trace.role: Narrowness against breadth makes the clause a loss of usable room.
The extended arm supplies an embodied radius for attempted protection.
Measurement by the arm turns that radius into a visibly finite span.
Capacity and range make the measured span an operational limit that has been exceeded.

changed_reading.before: ضاق بهم ذرعا is only an idiom for intense emotion.
changed_reading.after: The idiom stages emotion as an embodied failure of reach: Lot cannot see how his own arm, measure, or power can cover those who arrived.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا لا تخف ولا تحزن إنا منجوك
baseline_models.mechanism: Spoken reassurance separates anticipatory fear from grief's inner roughness and answers both with a concrete act of separation from danger, not with an abstract request to feel calm.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech makes reassurance an intervention delivered into the constricted scene.
Fear as expectation of harm supplies the forward-looking affect being checked.
Grief as inner roughness supplies a distinct affective burden rather than a synonym for fear.
Release by separation gives the speech an executable basis for its affective commands.

changed_reading.before: Do not fear and do not grieve is a doubled formula of comfort.
changed_reading.after: The speech regulates two horizons of distress by naming the extraction that changes the future while still leaving an explicit loss inside the promise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: منجوك وأهلك إلا امرأتك كانت من الغابرين
baseline_models.mechanism: The rescue declaration constructs a set and then cuts through its ordinary domestic boundary: spousehood names inclusion in one relation, while the exception and predicate assign the wife to the collectivity that remains.

activation_trace.role: Separation from danger supplies the operation by which the rescued set is formed.
The group of proximity and belonging supplies the initial household set.
The explicit woman or wife term makes the exception cut through a normally intimate bond.
Situated being in time presents her contrasting status as already operative.
Remaining after others pass places her in a second collectivity opposed to the extracted household.

changed_reading.before: The family is saved, with the wife added as an isolated exception.
changed_reading.after: The sentence performs a boundary judgment: domestic proximity does not by itself determine membership in the group that departs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contiguous sequence turns the apparent burden into an unrecognized answer: Lot asks for help, the messengers arrive with a dual announcement, state exact knowledge of who is inside, and only then arrive to him and identify themselves as rescuers.

activation_trace.role: The focus arrival is the event Lot initially reads through distress.
Distress supplies the initial negative valuation that the sequence reverses.
Aid and vindication supply Lot's immediately preceding request for intervention.
The matching arrival formula starts the disclosed answer before Lot recognizes it.
The same message-bearers connect the prior announcement to the focus arrival.
News that opens the face with joy gives the arrival a positive capacity alongside its destructive announcement.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the messengers' exact grasp of the population Lot cannot sort or secure.
The prior third-person rescue pledge reveals the function later spoken directly in the focus.

structural_cues: 29:30 requests aid; 29:31-32 disclose the agents, plan, and rescue set; 29:33 presents Lot's delayed recognition of them.
The focus pivots from two occurrences of بهم as pressure to قالوا as the pressure's speaking subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the contiguous request-arrival-plan encounter; I infer that the arrival functions as the answer before Lot recognizes it. A live alternative is that narrative succession need not itself assert a prayer-answer causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: The visitors create a crisis and then happen to offer relief.
changed_reading.after: The very figures Lot experiences as the crisis are the already-dispatched form of the help he requested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Whole-surah carrying language distinguishes failed human surety and creaturely non-self-sufficiency from the messengers' effective rescue pledge. Lot's shortened arm is therefore followed by a transfer of responsibility to agents who can actually bear it.

activation_trace.role: Constricted capacity supplies Lot's experienced inability to absorb the demand.
Finite range and capacity provide the personal limit from which responsibility must move.
The messengers' promised separation from danger supplies the effective assumption of agency.
Carrying as surety supplies the surah's explicit failed promise to take responsibility for others.
Literal carrying supplies a later image of creatures unable to carry their own provision and therefore dependent on another agency.

structural_cues: 29:12 denies the credibility of a human offer to carry another's liabilities, while 29:33 places an effective first-person plural rescue pledge after Lot's capacity fails.
29:60 repeats non-carrying immediately before assigning provision to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carrying failures, Lot's narrowed capacity, and the messengers' active pledge; I infer a transfer from inadequate personal surety to effective rescue agency. A live alternative is that حمل and ذرع remain parallel capacity images without a designed transfer.

changed_reading.before: Lot is overwhelmed and then receives a promise of safety.
changed_reading.after: His measured inability is the handoff point at which credible agents assume the protective burden that his own reach cannot carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offense immediately before the encounter includes severing the traversable road. Narrowed reach and rescue can therefore operate as route conditions: the social field has closed passage, and deliverance reopens movement into a wider domain.

activation_trace.role: Narrowness supplies the closed spatial condition experienced in the focus.
Stride, effort, and traversing distance turn the arm image toward blocked mobility as well as emotion.
Release by separation supplies movement out of the closed field.
Road-cutting by seizure or obstruction supplies the local mechanism that makes passage unsafe.
A traversable extended road identifies what the community has severed.
Breadth opposed to constriction supplies the later spatial countercondition to Lot's narrowness.
The surah's closing paths restore traversability at the far end of the blocked-road pattern.

structural_cues: 29:29 places قطع السبيل directly before Lot's plea and the messenger sequence.
The later أرضي واسعة and سبلنا answer constriction with breadth and plural routes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cut road, the focus's constricted range, rescue, later breadth, and paths; I infer that extraction restores traversability. A live alternative is that the later path language is ethical rather than spatial and only analogically sharpens the focus.

changed_reading.before: Rescue means protection from a threat at the same location.
changed_reading.after: Rescue is route work: it removes the household from a social space whose paths and protective reach have been closed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding verses alternate أهل as the population of the town and as Lot's intimate group. The wife's exception marks overlapping memberships, while the later weak-house image prevents dwelling or household form from functioning as an automatic shelter.

activation_trace.role: Proximity and belonging supply the household category that the promise initially names.
The wife term supplies domestic membership that does not settle rescue membership.
Remaining after others pass assigns the excepted wife to the nondeparting collective.
The same belonging root gathers the town's people into the collective marked for destruction.
The intervening rescue pledge narrows belonging from the town's people to Lot's people.
The return to the town's أهل supplies the collective from which the rescued household must separate.
House and household belonging supply a later social shell whose mere form offers no guaranteed protection.
Weakness of force makes the dwelling shell an unreliable basis for security.

structural_cues: 29:31 names أهل هذه القرية, 29:32 names أهله, 29:33 repeats أهلك with an exception, and 29:34 returns to أهل هذه القرية.
The wife remains grammatically close as spouse but is predicated among a different plural group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating scales of أهل, the exception, and a later weak house; I infer that trajectory and allegiance override co-residence when the rescue set is drawn. A live alternative is that the repeated أهل usages are locally distinct and the wife is simply an exception without a broader membership model.

changed_reading.before: A natural household remains intact except for one anomalous spouse.
changed_reading.after: Several affiliations overlap inside the town, and the utterance actively redraws the household as the subset that will leave rather than everyone who shares domestic proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated rescue episodes across the surah use separation at destructive boundaries: ship and flood, fire, doomed town, and vessel to land. In the focus, rescue thus implies removal from a medium of destruction, in exact contrast to the wife who remains.

activation_trace.role: Release by separation supplies the focus promise's core operation.
Remaining after others pass supplies the stationary counterposition to extraction.
Separation from danger supplies rescue associated with the ship after the flood seizure.
Separation from danger supplies rescue out of the fire episode.
The preannounced separation fixes extraction as the plan before the direct focus speech.
Separation from danger supplies movement from the vessel's peril to land.

structural_cues: The rescue occurrences are paired in their verses or immediate context with السفينة, النار, the doomed القرية, and البر.
29:32-34 contrast the group removed with punishment descending on the town's people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated نجو events at explicit material boundaries; I infer a shared topology of crossing out rather than being shielded in place. A live alternative is that the root contributes general deliverance without requiring one spatial template.

changed_reading.before: We will save you means that Lot and his family will survive.
changed_reading.after: We will save you promises a boundary crossing: the household is extracted from the doomed field while the excepted wife remains within it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from a person classified among those remaining to a punishment that descends and an effect deliberately left visible. This activates الغابرين not only as nondeparting people but as the human side of an event that produces a remainder and after-sign.

activation_trace.role: A remainder left after companions pass supplies the wife's contrastive temporal position.
Being situated in time presents that remainder-status as already established.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the immediate aftermath counterpart to الغابرين.
Manifest visibility turns what remains from mere debris into a legible sign.
Later visible dwellings reinforce the surah's pattern of aftermath made apparent.

structural_cues: 29:33 ends with الغابرين; 29:34 names the descending punishment; 29:35 immediately says تركنا منها آية بينة.
29:38 again makes prior destruction apparent from dwellings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remainder-language followed by a deliberately left visible sign; I infer an aftermath relation between the wife's assigned group and the event's residue. A live alternative is that الغابرين means only those who lag or remain and should not absorb the material-sign echo.

changed_reading.before: The wife is merely one of the people left behind.
changed_reading.after: She is assigned to the nondeparting side that becomes the catastrophe's aftermath, while those extracted pass beyond it; this does not make her literally identical with the later sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the nonliteral hospitality branch of ق ر ي beneath the ordinary settlement sense of القرية. It remains anchored in the focus's arriving messengers and Lot's narrowed protective reach; downstream prose should present it only as a branch echo, not as the lexical meaning of القرية here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: جاءت رسلنا لوطا ... وضاق بهم ذرعا

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the visitors whose reception creates the focus crisis.
Message-bearers supply the arriving persons toward whom protective responsibility is felt.
Finite reach supplies the host's inability to extend protection over the arrivals.
Hospitality to a guest from gathered food supplies an inverted civic function beneath the town label.

changed_reading.before: The town is only the geographical backdrop to Lot's private distress over visitors.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Lot's shortened arm exposes a civic anti-hospitality: the gathering called a town fails at receiving arrivals, forcing one host to bear an impossible collective duty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a remote cross-domain activation: the focus never calls the rescued group a sanctuary. It remains validly anchored in لا تخف, منجوك, and أهلك and is triggered by the later contrast of a protected precinct with people snatched around it; downstream prose should say the rescue behaves like a mobile protected boundary, not that the verse names one.

activation_trace.role: Expected harm supplies the affect that a protected boundary would normally quiet.
Release by separation makes protection mobile rather than fixed to the threatened place.
The belonging group supplies what moves together inside the proposed protective boundary.
A spatial sanctuary supplies the fixed enclosure against which the focus's moving rescue can be compared.
Swift snatching supplies the unsafe exterior condition surrounding protected space.
The region around a thing supplies the contrast between an interior refuge and exposed surroundings.

changed_reading.before: The messengers merely tell one frightened household that it will escape.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their assurance and extraction form a mobile sanctuary around the departing household while the surrounding civic space remains exposed.

strongest_changes: The arrival is retrospectively the answer to Lot's plea: the apparent burden is the rescue agency before it is recognized.
Lot's narrowed arm becomes a finite protective capacity whose responsibility is transferred to credible rescuers.
Alternating town and household uses of أهل turn the wife's exception into a judgment among overlapping affiliations.
Surah-wide نجو episodes make rescue an extraction across a destructive boundary, opposed to remaining in place.
The immediate تركنا منها آية sequence sharpens الغابرين toward aftermath and residue without forcing that secondary echo.
summary.what_was_special: The focus makes the same arrivals both the object of two بهم pressure phrases and the speaking subject of rescue, then refuses a frictionless happy ending by cutting the wife from the departing أهل.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether الغابرين should carry only ordinary remaining or also the immediate aftermath-residue echo.
Whether the carrying and path patterns are designed causal mechanisms or productive analogies activated by the focus idiom.
The civic-hospitality and mobile-sanctuary readings depend on explicitly contained, branch-distant associations.
